scripts.dev: concurrently -n fe,be -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @webonone/website-frontend" "npm run dev -w @webonone/website-backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:theme --prefix .. && npm run build:ui-kit --prefix .. && npm run build -w @webonone/website-frontend && npm run build -w @webonone/website-backend
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run stage:deploy
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w @webonone/website-frontend && npm run type-check -w @webonone/website-backend
